note: GET /api/ticket-status and /api/ticket-status/stuck read the last stage event of each ticket's NEWEST job (by job id, idx_events_job) for its last checkpoint. A job whose events are archived reads no row, and the checkpoint falls back to the job's updated_at and heartbeat. Read by test/archive-readers.bh-6779.test.js R1.
